label: The system
text: ST.O.A1.2 — Five competitive forces [porter-c01]; barriers to entry [porter-c02]; strategic groups and mobility barriers [porter-c07]. Balancing versus buck-passing as a choice set by structure and geography [mearsheimer-c08]. The offshore balancer [mearsheimer-c05]. One power reshaping the system [kissinger-c01]. Border: the explanatory theory of the international system (offensive realism's five assumptions [mearsheimer-c01]; multipolarity and war [mearsheimer-c09]) is PO.O.A5.1. ST.O.A1.2 uses PO.O.A5.1.

warrant.standard: Structure predicts choices across systems, with stated scope.
warrant.defeaters: Indeterminacy the theory admits [mearsheimer-c04]; few systems.
